scope: Common replay job-context correction, writer context, output descriptor, queues, tree insertion, and string boundaries

applied.name: KWReplayJobContext_Create
applied.evidence: The same 0xBB4-byte constructor is called with job_kind 1 by the reader path and job_kind 0 by the newly recovered writer path.

applied.name: KWReplayJobContext_Destroy
applied.evidence: The destructor is shared by both reader and writer job contexts.

applied.name: StreamQueue_PopFrontNode
applied.evidence: Unlinks and destroys the first common stream queue node.

applied.name: KWReplayWriterContext_CreateAndStart
applied.evidence: Builds job-kind 0 options, deep-copies the completed header, and starts the replay writer context.

applied.name: ReplayOutputDescriptor_Ctor
applied.evidence: Zero-initializes the complete 0x2C-byte replay output descriptor.

applied.name: FrameScheduleTree_InsertOrFind
applied.evidence: Performs ordered red-black-tree lookup/insertion by frame key.

applied.name: DuplicateWideStringOrNull
applied.evidence: Allocates and copies a nonempty UTF-16 string or returns null.

applied.name: DuplicateAsciiStringOrNull
applied.evidence: Allocates and copies a nonempty narrow string or returns null.

applied.name: CameraStreamQueueNode_RemoveAndFree
applied.evidence: Unlinks and frees the selected camera stream queue node.
